descripcion_geo: Territory east of the Jordan, in present-day southern Syria. Jephthah's refuge when he was expelled by his brothers.
importancia_estrategica: Land of refuge and rebellion; base of operations of Jephthah the leader.

historias.descripcion: Expelled by his brothers for being the son of a prostitute, Jephthah flees to the land of Tob where he gathers adventurous men.
The Ammonites hire soldiers from Tob to confront David in the war against Joab.

historias.titulo: Gilead Elders Bring Jephthah of Tob
historias.descripcion: Faced with the Ammonite threat, the elders of Gilead go to Tob to find Jephthah and appoint him chief.

personajes.descripcion: Taking refuge in Tob, he gathered a band of men; He returned as leader when Israel needed him.
They traveled to Tob to convince Jephthah to return as military leader.
They joined Jephthah in Tob; army base that liberated Gilead.

contexto_religioso.contexto_lugar: Tob: relevant geographical region in the Old Testament.

mitos.nombre: The rejected who becomes a savior

judaismo.descripcion: Jephthah, rejected because of his origin, becomes the savior of those who rejected him; biblical pattern of the despised chosen one.
judaismo.significado_teologico: Jephthah, rejected because of his origin, becomes the savior of those who rejected him; biblical pattern of the despised chosen one.
